direction.description: How the children are laid out. Defaults to horizontal.

Node.description: An icon, a group, a row or a column.

icon.description: Icon from the catalog, such as aws.ecs. Search with `yaml2drawio icons <word>`.

label.description: Text under the icon. Defaults to the icon's title.

id.description: Unique id, needed only to link to the group.

group.description: Group style, such as aws.vpc, aws.az or aws.private_subnet.

label.description: Title of the group. Defaults to the style's title.

direction.description: How the children are laid out. Defaults to horizontal.

align.description: How the children line up across the direction. expand gives them all the same size. Defaults to center.

border.description: Icons placed on the edge of the group, keyed by position (n, ne, e, ...).

children.description: What the group contains. Leave it out for an empty box, such as an unused subnet.

Group.description: A box around other nodes, such as a VPC or a subnet.

align.description: How the children line up across the direction. expand gives them all the same size. Defaults to center.

row.description: Nodes laid out left to right.

Row.description: Nodes laid out left to right without a box.

align.description: How the children line up across the direction. expand gives them all the same size. Defaults to center.

column.description: Nodes laid out top to bottom.

Column.description: Nodes laid out top to bottom without a box.

arrow.description: Which ends get an arrowhead. Defaults to end.

route.description: auto bends the line in the gaps around groups; drawio leaves the whole route to draw.io. Defaults to auto.

Link.description: A line: [from, to], or an object for a label or style.

Endpoint.description: An id, optionally followed by the side the line leaves or enters, such as alb.s (n, ne, e, se, s, sw, w, nw and the points between them).
